info.title: WhaleU source-aware current detail and discussion

get.description: Same authenticated legacy access policy and managed transaction. Unchanged nested DTO; server-owned explicit source discriminator. v6 requires exact current source, Review, Media, Campus, Community and Safety evidence. Denial/unknown evidence fails the entire read, never a legacy fallback. Only lossless derived presentation is optional. Preview identities must exactly match the existing nested preview. Discussion cursors remain scoped to the original parent/root/session/sort.
